checks.model: Synthetic localhost SSE, dummy credentials only

features: Blue circular up-arrow Send button becomes a solid white Stop square during PDF extraction or generation; cancel from either the retained page or floating window
Remove the green generation status strip while retaining live answer previews
Enter sends once, Shift+Enter inserts a line break, and IME composition or key code 229 does not submit
Textarea grows and retracts from 40 to 176 CSS pixels, scrolls internally at its height limit, and has no manual resize grip
Answer again with full paper is available on the original explanation and each assistant answer
Read the bound PDF through Zotero PDFWorker.getFullText(itemID, null) and send all extracted text only on explicit full-paper action
Regenerate each answer using its original question and relevant preceding conversation; replace in place while retaining message identity, later messages and drafts
Cancellation, extraction failure, stale or deleted jobs and context-limit errors retain the previous answer; do not store PDF full text in the knowledge-tree archive
Retain local TeX rendering for PDF selections, explanations, live draft preview and both conversation roles
Retain native PDF highlights linked to saved conversations; click to restore and delete a highlight to remove its conversation branch
Retain conservative model-output newline recovery, three interface languages, auto language selection and the logo-free interface

boundaries.nativeClickTest: Actual annotation sidebar card; PDF canvas coordinate clicks not separately simulated
boundaries.pdfExtraction: All extractable text from the bound PDF; scanned PDFs require OCR and missing formula symbols cannot be reliably reconstructed
boundaries.fullPaperContext: Full text is not truncated; provider context limits can reject long papers and the previous answer is retained
boundaries.fullPaperStorage: Full text is sent only after choosing the action and is not written into the archive
boundaries.realProvider: Network model requests are mocked; real paid API availability and answer quality are not verified
boundaries.nativeFullPaperTest: Actual Zotero PDFWorker extraction, exact mock request, native keyboard/IME/SVG controls, HTTP 413, cancellation and full process restart
boundaries.historicalTextOnlySessions: No automatic highlight creation without PDF selection geometry
boundaries.newlineRecovery: Conservative layout-based recovery; ambiguous single literal breaks, incomplete code and path suffixes may remain unchanged
boundaries.normalizationScope: Model output only; user input and PDF selections are preserved
